reference_sql:
SELECT ol.order_id, ol.order_line_id,
       ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS line_value,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur)
             / SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id), 2) AS order_share_pct
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE o.channel = 'web'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-11'

  SELECT o.order_id, ol.order_line_id,
         ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS line_value
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.channel = 'web'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-11 00:00:00'
)
SELECT order_id, order_line_id, line_value,
       ROUND(100.0 * line_value / SUM(line_value) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id), 2) AS order_share_pct
FROM l
